listing.name: MediEvil / MediEvilRecomp (BlackLabelHQ)
listing.summary: Play MediEvil natively with your own supported North American disc.

steps.title: Choose your original disc in the game
steps.instruction: Choose Play, then use MediEvil’s disc picker to select your own supported North American MediEvil CUE/BIN or CHD. The game validates the disc and remembers its path, so keep the disc in a folder outside the game folder. Portcove does not supply original game files.

steps.title: Run a copy you manage yourself
steps.instruction: Extract the official package for your system (Windows x64 ZIP, Linux x64 TAR.GZ, or macOS Apple Silicon or Intel ZIP) into a separate folder and start medievil.exe (medievil on Linux and macOS) from that folder. The player needs the .NET 10 runtime and OpenAL; follow upstream's prerequisite instructions if either is missing. To add that copy to Portcove, select the player and its folder.

warnings: The project publishes no licence, and the package bundles the recompiled game code and third-party libraries without their licence notices. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

In a copy you manage yourself, the in-game updater replaces the game's program files. Keep a copy of your working folder, including settings.json, interface.ini, the memory-card files and mods, before updating.

references.title: Keep the game folder's data
references.instruction: The game keeps settings.json, interface.ini, the carda.sav and cardb.sav memory cards, mods, shader and asset packs (shaders, packs), texture dumps (dump) and the mod hub cache (.modhub) in its own folder. Back up that folder and keep your disc separately before replacing a copy you manage yourself.

presentation.manual_preparation: Requires the .NET 10 runtime. On first Play, use MediEvil's disc picker to select your own supported North American MediEvil CUE/BIN or CHD; the game remembers the disc's path, so keep the disc in a folder outside the game folder. Portcove starts the game with --disable-updated, upstream's switch for an external manager, which removes its update check, Updates menu and installer, so only Portcove replaces the managed copy. Settings, memory-card saves, the interface layout, mods, shader and asset packs, texture dumps and the mod hub cache stay in the game folder and are kept across updates, backups and rollback. Keep the memory cards at their default names, carda.sav and cardb.sav. Mods run code you choose to install.
